## Core Technical Specialization
- **Backend Architecture & Multi-Stack APIs**: Python 3, Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, JWT Authentication, Microservices, Celery, Redis.
- **Frontend & Cross-Platform Mobile**: React 19, Next.js (App Router), React Native, Expo (iOS & Android), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Responsive UI Design.
- **AI Tooling & Autonomous Workflows**: AI Coding Agents, Prompt Engineering for Code Generation, OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Whisper Speech-to-Text, CLI Tooling, Git Conventional Commits, npm Package Publishing.
- **Databases & Cloud**: PostgreSQL (Normalized Schemas, Query Optimization, Foreign Keys), MongoDB, Supabase (Row-Level Security / RLS), AWS, Docker, Vercel.
- **Payment & Security**: Razorpay Payment Gateway, Stripe Webhook Verification, Token Refresh Rotation, CORS, Environment Isolation.
